# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the canonical repository rules in [`/AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before making changes.

Use the scoped instructions in `.github/instructions/`, repository skills in `.github/skills/`, and prompts in `.github/prompts/` where applicable. Follow the exact build, test, and deployment commands in `README.md` and `docs/`; do not dispatch or initiate production deployment.
